prompt: Which of these is a real-world example of unsupervised learning?

An e-commerce company grouping customers by purchase behavior with no predefined categories
A robot vacuum that gets penalized for bumping walls and rewarded for cleaning more floor space
A regression model predicting house prices from square footage and bedroom count

prompt: In the feature matrix / label setup used throughout this module (X, y = ...), what does y represent?

The value the model is trying to predict for each example

prompt: Why do you need a validation split in addition to train and test, rather than just train and test?

Test sets are always too small to train a model properly
If you use the test set to choose between models or hyperparameters, that same test set can no longer give an honest, unbiased estimate of final performance

Underfitting, i.e. high bias
